speaker: JUNO
text: [breathless, dramatic] What if Roblox... shut down... FOREVER?

speaker: LAG
text: [slow, deep, glitchy] One... min... min... minute... left.

speaker: DEX
text: [panicking] Juno! There's no respawn in real life! I checked!

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [shouting] Hold on to your helmets!

speaker: JUNO
text: [determined, shouting] Pip! Press the button!

speaker: PIP
text: [cheerful, tiny] Ding!

speaker: JUNO
text: [calm, to camera] Okay. You're probably wondering how a girl in a hard hat ended up running from a giant lag monster.

speaker: JUNO
text: [storyteller] Let's go back twenty-four hours.

speaker: JUNO
text: [cheerful] Hi! I'm Juno. I'm eleven. And I'm a builder.

speaker: JUNO
text: [proud] That's why I wear the hard hat. [pause] Builders wear hard hats. [pause] Also, I fall off my chair a lot.

speaker: JUNO
text: Not houses. Games. For three years, I've been building my own Roblox game.

speaker: JUNO
text: [proud, dreamy] It's called Bubble Island. Islands... inside bubbles. You float from one to the next. [pause] It's a masterpiece.

speaker: JUNO
text: [deadpan] It has three visits.

speaker: JUNO
text: One is me. One is my cat. And one is Grandpa, by accident. He thought it was the weather app.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [confused, warm] Juno, why is tomorrow's weather... soap?

speaker: JUNO
text: That's Grandpa Otto. He lives with us. He carries one hundred keys... and he won't tell anyone what they open.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [mysterious, whispering] Some doors... are better left closed.

speaker: JUNO
text: [aside] He also uses a mop as a walking stick. Nobody knows why.

speaker: JUNO
text: Mom and Dad don't play. [pause] Dad says video games rot your brain.

speaker: JUNO
text: And this is my best friend, Dex.

speaker: DEX
text: [cocky, fast] Twelve thousand hours. Every obby. Every boss. Every badge. I have NEVER fallen. Not once.

speaker: JUNO
text: [aside, deadpan] In the game. In real life... he's scared of stairs.

speaker: DEX
text: [nervous] Stairs don't have checkpoints, Juno! If I fall, where do I spawn?!

speaker: JUNO
text: [deadpan] On the floor, Dex. You spawn on the floor.

speaker: JUNO
text: And this is my little brother, Pip. He's six. He plays exactly one game.

speaker: PIP
text: [excited, tiny] Elevator Simulator!

speaker: PIP
text: [happy] Ding!

speaker: JUNO
text: He has ridden the same elevator... forty-one thousand times. He knows every button in every elevator in the game.

speaker: PIP
text: [proud] Ding!

speaker: JUNO
text: [sighs] It's the only word he's said since Christmas.

speaker: JUNO
text: [storyteller] It was a normal Tuesday. Six p.m. Peak gaming hour.

speaker: JUNO
text: And then... every screen in the world... showed the same message.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm, polite, robotic] Attention, players. Roblox will shut down forever... in twenty-four hours.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] Thanks for playing! Smiley face.

speaker: DEX
text: [devastated, screaming] FOREVER?! Like... FOREVER forever?!

speaker: DEX
text: [sobbing] I have a nine-hundred-day login streak!

speaker: PIP
text: [small, sad] ...Even the elevator?

speaker: DAD
text: [nervous, whispering] It's fine. It's just a game. [pause] ...Not my fish. Please, not my fish.

speaker: JUNO
text: [panicked] My game isn't finished! Bubble Island has no ending! The bubbles don't even POP yet!

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [dramatic, news] Breaking news! The world has entered... the Final Twenty-Four Hours!

speaker: ANCHOR
text: Schools are closed. Parents are confused. And one kid has already fainted. [pause] Twice.

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [dramatic] Ten thousand players are trying to beat the same obby at the same time. [pause] And a dog has learned to say "oof."

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [serious] Experts say the shutdown cannot be stopped. [pause] Experts also say they're going to go play now. Goodbye!

speaker: JUNO
text: The countdown started. And the whole world... went a little bit crazy.

speaker: JUNO
text: Everybody made a list. The "last day" list.

speaker: JUNO
text: Kids spent the Robux they'd been saving for years.

speaker: JUNO
text: Every server was full. Every obby had a line. One obby had a line... for the line.

speaker: JUNO
text: One guy finally read the Terms of Service. All of them. [pause] It took eleven hours. He said the ending was disappointing.

speaker: JUNO
text: Even our math teacher canceled the test... so he could finish his tycoon.

speaker: STREAMER
text: [hyped, screaming] Chat! This is the last stream EVER! I will not blink! I will not sleep! [pause] I will not... [yawns] ...okay, maybe one nap.

speaker: DAD
text: [serious, emotional] Kids. Sit down. I need to tell you something.

speaker: DAD
text: [ashamed] I'm level nine hundred... in a fishing game.

speaker: JUNO
text: [shocked] Dad! You said video games rot your brain!

speaker: DAD
text: [defensive] It's not a game! It's RELAXING! [voice cracking] And tonight... I was finally going to catch the Golden Fish!

speaker: JUNO
text: Even Mom had a list.

speaker: JUNO
text: [deadpan] She said she was taking a bath. [pause] For six hours.

speaker: DEX
text: [stressed] I have every badge in Roblox... except one. The secret one. The "Touch Grass" badge.

speaker: DEX
text: [frustrated] Nobody knows how to get it! I searched every map! Every cave! Every... grass texture!

speaker: PIP
text: [sad, tiny] Goodbye, Mister Elevator Man. You were the best elevator man.

speaker: PIP
text: [sad, small] Ding. [pause] Ding. [pause] ...Ding.

speaker: JUNO
text: [determined] And me? I had one thing on my list. Finish Bubble Island. Before the world forgot it ever existed.

speaker: DEX
text: [confused] Juno... I just fell through the whole world.

speaker: JUNO
text: [quickly] That's not a bug. That's... the secret underwater level.

speaker: DEX
text: [deadpan] There's no water. It's just grey. Forever.

speaker: JUNO
text: [defeated] ...It's a very secret level.

speaker: JUNO
text: [tired] At midnight, I was almost done. Twelve islands. Three hundred bubbles. One very tired builder.

speaker: JUNO
text: [uneasy] Then my game started... lagging.

speaker: LAG
text: [slow, deep, glitchy] Mmm... bub... bub... bubbles.

speaker: JUNO
text: [startled] Who said that?!

speaker: LAG
text: [slow, deep, glitchy] I... am... [long pause] ...the LAAAG.

speaker: LAG
text: [hungry, slow] More players... more... rushing... more... FOOD.

speaker: JUNO
text: [brave, shaky] Get out of my game! This is MY game!

speaker: LAG
text: [slow, mocking] Your... game... has... three... visits. [pause] Nobody... will... miss... it.

speaker: JUNO
text: [hurt, quiet] ...Rude.

speaker: JUNO
text: [whispering, scared] And then my cat... lagged. In REAL LIFE.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [grave, quiet] So. He's back.

speaker: JUNO
text: [shocked] Grandpa?! You KNOW about the lag monster?!

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [serious] Juno... for thirty years, I was the night janitor... at the Server Farm.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [proud, mysterious] The place where all of Roblox lives.

speaker: JUNO
text: [stunned] So the hundred keys...

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [proud] Ninety-nine of them open the Server Farm. [pause] One opens my locker. There's a sandwich in there from nineteen ninety-eight.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: Back then, the Lag was tiny. I'd shoo him away with my mop. But he feeds on traffic. The more everyone rushes at once... the bigger he gets.

speaker: JUNO
text: [realizing] And today... the whole world is rushing at once.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: That's why they're shutting it all down. To starve him. Forever.

speaker: JUNO
text: [determined] So if we stop the Lag... Roblox doesn't have to shut down?

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [grinning] Get your helmet, builder.

speaker: JUNO
text: At six a.m., we had a van, a key... and a team.

speaker: DEX
text: [scared] No way. Real life has no respawn, no checkpoints, and no mini-map!

speaker: JUNO
text: [calm] It has snacks.

speaker: DEX
text: [pause] ...I'm in.

speaker: PIP
text: [cheerful] Ding!

speaker: JUNO
text: [sighs] And a stowaway.

speaker: JUNO
text: The closer we got to the Server Farm... the laggier the world became.

speaker: DEX
text: [nervous, whispering] Juno. That cow is... loading.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [cheerful] Don't worry! Betsy hasn't gone over forty miles an hour since nineteen ninety-eight!

speaker: DEX
text: [deadpan] Did we just... lag backwards?

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [robotic, glitchy] Recalculating. Recalculating. Re... re... recalculating.

speaker: JUNO
text: [laughs] Twelve hours left. And we were going backwards.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [serious] The Lag lives in the Core. The very bottom floor. Nobody's been down there in years.

speaker: JUNO
text: And when we get there... what's the plan?

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [cheerful] I was hoping you had one. You're the builder.

speaker: JUNO
text: [deadpan] Great. Great plan, Grandpa.

speaker: JUNO
text: We stopped for gas. [pause] The cashier was... buffering.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [polite] One coffee, please.

speaker: DEX
text: [whispering] Is he okay?

speaker: CASHIER
text: [fast, glitchy] That'll-be-two-dollars-have-a-nice-day-have-a-nice-day-have-a-nice-day.

speaker: PIP
text: [whiny, tiny] Are we there yet? [pause] Ding?

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [chuckles, warm] Not yet, little elevator.

speaker: DEX
text: [quiet, surprised] Huh. The graphics out here are... actually really good.

speaker: JUNO
text: [awed] The Server Farm. Every game. Every avatar. Every obby ever made. All in one building.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [nostalgic, warm] Thirty years... and she hasn't changed a bit.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [offended] Expired?! I mopped these floors for thirty years!

speaker: MODBOT
text: [robotic, stern] Intruders detected! Leave now, or you will be... beep beep beep beep!

speaker: DEX
text: [scared] Did that robot just get chat-filtered?!

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [fake robot voice, badly] Beep. Boop. I am... also a robot. Nothing to see here.

speaker: MODBOT
text: [robotic, suspicious] ...Welcome, colleague.

speaker: DEX
text: [whispering, amazed] That should NOT have worked.

speaker: DEX
text: [sneezing] Ah... ah... ACHOO!

speaker: MODBOT
text: [robotic, alarmed] Intruders! Intruders! Beep beep beep!

speaker: JUNO
text: [panicked] A service elevator with four hundred buttons! Nobody knows which one—

speaker: PIP
text: [calm, expert] Basement nine. Then up two. Then hold "close door" for three seconds.

speaker: PIP
text: [proud] Ding!

speaker: JUNO
text: [amazed] Forty-one thousand elevator rides... and they finally paid off.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [impressed, warm] That's my grandson.

speaker: PIP
text: [whispering] Ding.

speaker: JUNO
text: Floor one. The Cooling Room. Where the servers chill out.

speaker: DEX
text: [screaming] No respawn! No respawn! NO RESPAWN!

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [cheerful] Thirty years of mopping, kid! Bend your knees!

speaker: PIP
text: [giggling] Ding!

speaker: JUNO
text: Floor two. The Cable Jungle.

speaker: DEX
text: [scared] Juno, I can't. That's a real gap. With real... falling.

speaker: JUNO
text: [warm] Dex. Look at it. Platforms. Swinging ropes. A gap. [pause] What does that look like?

speaker: DEX
text: [slowly realizing] ...It's an obby. [excited] It's just an OBBY!

speaker: DEX
text: [hyped] Twelve thousand hours of practice, BABY!

speaker: JUNO
text: Floor two and a half. The Lost and Found. Every item anyone ever lost in a game.

speaker: DEX
text: [gasps, excited] My first sword! I lost it in third grade!

speaker: PIP
text: [happy] Ding!

speaker: JUNO
text: [awed, whispering] Floor three. The Archive.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [warm] Every game anyone ever made... is kept here. Every single one.

speaker: JUNO
text: [touched] Even mine.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [gentle] Especially yours. Every world someone builds with love... gets a shelf.

speaker: JUNO
text: [quiet] I always thought my game didn't matter. Three visits. [pause] But somebody kept it anyway.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [warm] A game doesn't need a million visits to matter, Juno. It just needs someone who made it.

speaker: JUNO
text: [scared] But at the end of the hall... the bubbles were turning grey.

speaker: LAG
text: [booming, slow, glitchy] More... players... more... rushing... MORE... FOOD.

speaker: JUNO
text: [whispering] Every player on Earth was rushing to play one last game. And every one of them... was feeding him.

speaker: DEX
text: [cocky] Stand back. I've beaten every boss in Roblox.

speaker: JUNO
text: Dex, wait—

speaker: DEX
text: [muffled, groans] ...Real life is SO badly designed.

speaker: LAG
text: [laughing slowly, glitchy] Ha. [pause] Ha. [pause] Ha. [pause] Ha.

speaker: LAG
text: [slow, booming] Tomorrow... no more... games. No more... obbies. No more... elevators.

speaker: PIP
text: [angry, tiny] ...Not the elevator.

speaker: JUNO
text: [determined] My turn. I'm a BUILDER!

speaker: LAG
text: [slow, mocking] Wall... not... loaded.

speaker: JUNO
text: [annoyed] Oh, come ON!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm, robotic] Shutdown in five minutes. Thanks for playing! Smiley face.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [shocked] My mop! He ate my MOP!

speaker: JUNO
text: [thinking out loud] Grandpa... you said he eats traffic. Everybody rushing at once.

speaker: JUNO
text: [slowly, realizing] What if there was NO traffic? Not forever. Just for... ten seconds?

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [realizing] If every single player logged off at the same time... he'd have nothing to eat.

speaker: DEX
text: [disbelief] Juno! Nobody logs off! Not on the LAST DAY!

speaker: JUNO
text: [determined] Then we ask. Everyone. At once.

speaker: LAG
text: [slow, deep, glitchy] One... min... min... minute... left.

speaker: JUNO
text: [shouting] Pip! Press the button!

speaker: PIP
text: [cheerful, tiny] Ding!

speaker: JUNO
text: [nervous, then sincere] Um. Hi. I'm Juno. I'm eleven. I'm... a builder.

speaker: JUNO
text: I know it's the last day. I know you want to play every single second. Me too.

speaker: JUNO
text: But there's a monster eating our servers. And he eats when we all rush.

speaker: JUNO
text: [sincere] We can play tomorrow. And the day after. But only if we stop... right now.

speaker: JUNO
text: [softly, sincere] So please... just for ten seconds... put down your phone. Log off. [pause] And look up.

speaker: STREAMER
text: [quiet, sincere] Chat... I'll be right back.

speaker: JUNO
text: [softly] And then... one by one... the world logged off.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [robotic] Players online: eight hundred million...

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [robotic] Ten million... ten thousand... ten...

speaker: LAG
text: [panicking, slow] No... no... come... back... play... one... more...

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [quiet] Players online... zero.

speaker: DEX
text: [whispering, amazed] ...The Touch Grass badge.

speaker: LAG
text: [tiny, cute, high-pitched] ...hi.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [surprised, robotic] Lag... not found. [pause] Shutdown... canceled!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] Thanks for playing! Smiley face.

speaker: JUNO
text: [laughing, crying] We did it! We actually DID it!

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [proud, warm] Ten seconds. That's all the world needed.

speaker: DEX
text: [running, excited] Juno! I touched grass! I TOUCHED GRASS!

speaker: JUNO
text: [laughing] We know, Dex. We know.

speaker: PIP
text: [whispering] Can I keep him?

speaker: JUNO
text: [pause] ...Fine. But you're feeding him.

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [cheerful] Good morning! Roblox is staying! Scientists are calling it "The Great AFK": the first time in history... the whole world went outside at the same time.

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [pause] Everyone agrees it was weird. [pause] And kind of nice.

speaker: DAD
text: [crying happily] It was worth the wait!

speaker: DEX
text: [proud] Ten minutes of real life a day. [pause] Still no respawn. But the graphics are amazing.

speaker: JUNO
text: [happy, amazed] And Bubble Island? Three visits... became three MILLION.

speaker: JUNO
text: [proud] Oh, and I finally finished it. Now the bubbles pop.

speaker: JUNO
text: Pip rode a real elevator for the first time. [pause] He gave it two stars. Too slow.

speaker: PIP
text: [disappointed] ...Ding.

speaker: JUNO
text: And Mom finally finished her bath. [pause] She was a little wrinkly.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [cheerful] They gave me my old job back! Night janitor! [pause] Best job in the world.

speaker: JUNO
text: [warm] And now, every year, on the same day... we all log off for ten seconds. [pause] Just to say hi to the real world.

speaker: PIP
text: [proud] His name is Buffer.

speaker: DAD
text: [annoyed, glitchy] Juno... why... is... the... Wi... Wi... Wi-Fi...

speaker: JUNO
text: [to camera, deadpan] ...Here we go again.

speaker: JUNO
text: [warm, to camera] So... what would YOU do if Roblox had only twenty-four hours left? Tell me in the comments!

speaker: JUNO
text: And hey... maybe log off for ten seconds today. Look up. [pause] Then come right back and watch another video!

speaker: PIP
text: [cheerful] Ding!
